loci.label: Ars Poetica 453–476, the mad poet and Empedocles

scope: Horace's poems entire in Latin, six works in six TEI files at one pinned commit of PerseusDL/canonical-latinLit. The editions differ by work, as Perseus carries them; each is named with its file.
why_seated: At the operator's ruling of 2026-10-28, on the proposals of Belief & Technique for Telepathic Prose: A Critical Edition (§11): the Ars Poetica is the genre's founding text, whose close (the mad poet in the pit, Empedocles in Etna, 453–476) the Footnote to Pearl distributes through its list. The shelf held Longinus (01/06) and no Horace.
